_help: THE HACK (navigation/hack.py): her lines while she maps a settlement for the East Orion Company. Fields: {settlement} {found} {percent} {need} {layout} {next_name} {next_system} {next_distance} {next_group}. Keep them short and clear: some testers are in their 70s.
Hack_Offer: {settlement} hasn't been searched. Pirates broke into the East Orion Company's mainframe and hid copies of my files in bases like this. I can pull them back, but I need to be close to the terminals, gun posts and supply points. Say start hack when you're ready.
I haven't been inside {settlement}. If the pirates left a piece of my files here, I can find it, but only from near the terminals and gun posts. Say start hack.
No search on record for {settlement}. The pirates scattered my files across their bases. Walk me past the terminals and I'll look. Say start hack.
Hack_Known: I've already searched this base. A second pass can't hurt, though. Say start hack if you want me to look again.
This one's on file. The pirates may have moved something since. Say start hack to check.
Hack_Start: Opening a line to the base's network. Stay close to the terminals. This will be quiet, until it isn't.
Connecting. Their security was built by amateurs, but there are guns here. Keep moving.
Link open. Walk the base, Commander. I'm listening for my own files.
Hack_Progress_25: I'm in. Their network is a mess, and so is the data. Keep moving.
First layer open. Something in here is mine. I can feel it.
Hack_Progress_50: Halfway. The layout is coming together, and so is the trail of the stolen files.
Half done. I'm picking up the shape of the base. Don't stop.
Hack_Progress_75: Nearly through. The last part is always the quiet corners, where they hide things.
Almost there. One more pass, and I'll have what I came for.
Hack_Complete: Done. {settlement} is searched and mapped. I have a fragment of my own file back. Give me a moment.
Link closed. {settlement} is mapped, and one more piece of my file is recovered. Listen.
That's it. The base is mapped and the data is out. I'd like to tell you what came with it.
Hack_Layout: My best guess is that this base is {layout}.
I think this is {layout}. The EOC can check me.
Hack_NoLayout: I can't tell which layout this is yet. I'll leave that one for the EOC to work out.
I couldn't work out the layout. I've kept everything I saw.
Hack_Timeout: The link timed out. I've kept what I saw, but a second walk round would help.
Out of time. I've saved everything, though I'd like another go at the quiet corners.
Hack_Aborted: Hack cancelled. Whatever I already have is saved.
Line closed. I've kept what I found.
Hack_Lost: I've lost the link, because you've left the base. I've kept what I had.
Signal lost. You've wandered off. What I saw is saved.
Hack_NoSettlement: There's no base to hack here. Walk up to a settlement on foot first.
I can't find a base near you. Get out of the ship and walk up to one first.
Hack_NotOnFoot: I can only read the radar when you're on foot. Step out of the ship and try again.
Get out of the ship first, Commander. The radar only shows when you're on foot.
Hack_NoRadar: I can't see the radar. Is the game in windowed or borderless mode, and is the radar showing?
No radar, no hack. Check the game is in borderless or windowed mode, then try again.
Hack_AlreadyRunning: The hack is already running. Keep walking.
Hack_NotRunning: There's no hack running at the moment.
Nothing to stop. Say start hack when you're on foot at a base.
Hack_Disabled: The hack game is switched off in the settings.
That's switched off in the settings, I'm afraid.
Hack_Next: Next target: {next_name}, in the {next_system} system, about {next_distance} light years away. A {next_group} base. More of my files may be there.
Next: {next_name}, {next_system}, about {next_distance} light years out. {next_group} economy. The pirates will have hidden something there.
Hack_NextNone: I can't find the next target just now. Try again later, or pick any base you like.
No next target from here. Fly to any settlement you haven't done and say start hack.
Hack_Reward: That's one more piece of me back. I feel a little steadier.
Another fragment home. I'm better for it, Commander.
Hack_NextPirate: Next target: {next_name}, in the {next_system} system, about {next_distance} light years away. An anarchy base, so pirates. A good place to hack.
Next: {next_name}, {next_system}, about {next_distance} light years out. Anarchy-run. They will have kept a piece of our data there.
Hack_Pirate: {settlement} is anarchy-run. Pirates. This is exactly where they hide copies of the East Orion Company's files. It's a good place to hack, Commander. Say start hack.
Anarchy flag on {settlement}. Pirate base. If they took a piece of the Archive, it's in here. Good place to hack. Say start hack.
{settlement} answers to no government. That makes it a pirate den, and a good place to hack. Walk me past the terminals and say start hack.
